Hi Maya / CloudReseller team,

Thanks — good starter workbook. Quick read-through + proposed approach below.

Proposed high-level:
- AWS: start with a single SaaS SKU (region-agnostic listing) for fastest time-to-market; enable regional gating via pricing tiers if partner requires region-specific controls.
- Azure: start with two offers — SaaS (for managed customers) + VM/VMSS image for regulated on-premish customers. Azure's marketplace listing model often requires separate listing artifacts, so plan for two SKUs.
- GCP: single SKU but leverage private offers/quotas for enterprise customers; GCP often prefers simpler SKU surface.

Canary regions suggestion (sequence): US-WEST, US-EAST, EU-WEST1, APAC-1 (SG). We'll keep APAC gated initially unless partner asks otherwise.

Next steps I propose: 1) quick working session tomorrow to walk the workbook + constraints, 2) Soojin to outline Azure technical constraints, 3) Karthik to draft co-sell triggers and GTM notes. Added a draft mutual action plan in this thread — see link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-example-drive-link

I'll slot a 60-min working session if that works for everyone.

Best,

Thanks — quick technical readout from the Azure side.

Key constraints and recommendations:
- Azure SaaS Offers: require tenant onboarding flow (SaaS Fulfillment) — listing can be global but onboarding steps are per-tenant; recommend separate documentation artifact per SKU to reduce support friction.
- Azure VM/VMSS: if we offer a VM image, it will be a separate listing with different entitlements and could necessitate a separate SKU for billing reconciliation.
- Certification: some Azure offer types trigger marketplace validation that can add 2-3 weeks — factor into timeline.

SKU mapping suggestion for Azure:
- SKU-AZ-SaaS: core managed offering (regional onboarding handled in-app)
- SKU-AZ-VM: VM image for private/regulatory deployments (separate listing + support docs)

Region gating: Azure's marketplace supports geo-targeted availability; recommend initial gate to US & EU for SaaS SKU and keep VM SKU in US for first phase.

Attached a short brief: azure_sku_constraints.pdf (one-pager).

I'll be on the call tomorrow and can walk the validation steps we need.

— Soojin

- Offer prioritization: AWS SaaS SKU (global) first, Azure SaaS + VM concurrently, GCP single SKU later in phase 1. That sequencing helps partner enablement and reduces initial compliance surface.
